instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Give the latest answers to a form as plain lines, each starting with the question it answers, ready to hand to a writer or a summary", and give it form_id (The form).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-latest-answers-as-lines and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give form_id and optionally respondent_id.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: answer-fact (records:list); question-sequence (records:list).
